Vera K.: nightly CI scan failed on release/rc: SAST flagged serialization/encode.go (high) and artifact fetch failed due to KMS decrypt=403 for signer-sa. Can @Tom or @Anya triage?
Tom S.: scan run: https://ci.example.com/runs/101420 - security-bot summary below
security-bot: nightly-scan 4440001111: result=FAIL, sast=1 high, dast=0, infra=KMS_DECRYPT=403 principal=signer-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Anya P.: artifact log: "rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Caller does not have permission to access cryptoKeys/signer-key, principal=signer-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
infra-automation: applied policy bundle CH-2491 at 2026-04-12T03:00Z for project:redwood-prod. No manual intent recorded.
Tom S.: SAST looks real - encode.go uses gob.Encoder on untrusted input without length checks. I'll open a hotfix PR; ETA 90m. No suppression.
Vera K.: ops suggestion to unblock: add conditional key-level decrypter binding for signer-sa with 3h TTL. Post change only after audit evidence attached.
ops-oncall: dry-run command: gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding signer-key --keyring=signing --location=global --member='serviceAccount:signer-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter' --condition="expression=request.time < timestamp('2026-04-12T10:00:00Z'),title=temporary_scan_unblock" --project=redwood-prod
Anya P.: running auditlog query now to see who modified bindings: gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.labels.keyRingId="signing"' --limit 20 --project=redwood-prod
infra-automation: auditlog shows SetIamPolicy by infra-automation@redwood-tools at 2026-04-12T03:00Z that replaced key IAM and removed signer-sa binding. Opening CH-2491 follow-up with evidence.
Vera K.: Tom, merge hotfix and backport. Ops, apply conditional grant after attaching CH-2491 evidence. Anya, create incident stub if infra confirms accidental removal.
Tom S.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/serialization/pull/78 (adds size cap + unit tests).
ops-oncall: applied conditional binding and annotated CH-2491. Re-run queued.
security-bot: re-run 101421: overall=PASS, sast=PASS, infra=artifact-fetch=OK
Vera K.: Follow-ups: infra to fix policy generator to preserve key-level bindings; add nightly preflight `gcloud kms keys test-iam-permissions` for signer-key; document conditional grant steps in runbook. Creating incident stub if needed.
